notes.title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 | Update on the release date of Playtest CO-OP Mode
notes.notes:
Dear community,

Last week we promised that the Playtest of CO-OP Mode would be available this week, but unfortunately, with great heartache, we have to inform you about the change of the Playtest release date.

Currently, the entire team is involved in bug fixes for Warships DLC, which really surprised us. As a small development team, we want to first improve the stability of the Warships DLC and then fully focus on the Playtest of CO-OP Mode so that you can fully enjoy smashing ships with hammers with your friends, that's why we need a few more days.

Therefore, we decided to change the Playtest release date. We want to be absolutely sure that you - our community - who support our game by purchasing DLC, could enjoy the game without any problems.

Thank you for your understanding - the entire team is working very hard to make sure you can fully experience this next milestone with Ship Graveyard Simulator 2. We assure you that the Playtest version will be ready soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201940/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator_2/


We will get back to you with further information - thank you. 🤝
Ship Graveyard Simulator Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/37997ee19113c9f083c2cd295f937988e34ee481.png

notes.title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 | CO-OP MODE PLAYTEST - RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Warships DLC is now available! But that's not all we have prepared for you today... 👀


⚓ The Playtest of the CO-OP mode will start in the coming week! ⚓


Get ready to play in a completely new mode with your friends! Playtest will be available to everyone, but don't miss the opportunity to play soon, and sign up now!

How to sign up? Let us explain that step by step:
1. Login to your Steam account
2. Go to the Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 Steam page
3. Scroll a little lower on the page
4. You will see the banner like below, and click the green button "request access"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/ce21a569482684bb422c3beef90037404f7fb701.gif

Now wait for the email with the invite. 📧



While you wait for the Playtest, you can now destroy Warships! 🔥 
Check what we have prepared! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37206/MASSIVE_SHIP_GRAVEYARD/

Have fun!
Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 Team

notes.title: SGS2 | RELEASE DATE SET! 🔥
notes.notes:
Let's start August with good news! 🥳

Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 will launch:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201940/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator_2/

Mark this date on your calendar 🗓️ because on this day you will be able to take the hammer in your hands and smash some shipwrecks 💪

Just a few days ago we announced that the game will be released in August 2023, and today we are sure that the game will be available on Steam on August 16, 2023, at 3:00 PM CEST

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Dear Fans 🛳️

As we announced last month - UPCOMING UPDATES - we have prepared a very big update for Ship Graveyard Simulator. We tried to meet most of your ideas, suggestions and expectations. In the update you can download right now, the most important changes are:
✅ Game-changing balance, new difficulties: Normal and Easy. The current balance will be easy mode and new changes to normal mode.
✅ New game mechanic - the destruction progress bar.
✅ New achievements connected with destroying every ship in the game.
THE FULL LIST OF CHANGES IS BELOW
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/ed8412d3e4331698891267cf5c1d619fce714156.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/53fa019256ff5a0bee1613e037b4732344b0b729.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/4e9e2b962516b0f9087d9f6c18d76515b8ee5de6.png

Once again, we would like to thank everyone who purchased our game for your amazing commitment both before and after the premiere. On Steam Community Hub and our Discord server, you have created an amazing community that has provided us with a lot of valuable information.

The game is still in development and we'll have more news for you, so be sure to keep checking upcoming news. 😊

That's not all we have prepared! 👇
In addition, when we were working on the big update, we were collecting feedback from you all the time and in this update, which you can download now, it contains many new fixes and improvements for the game, below is a detailed list of changes:

 Booking button disappearing.
 Steel post texture.
 Roebuck Ship third, fourth floor stuck door.
 Roebuck Ship third, fith, seventh floor hole in the wall.
 Roebuck Ship second floor see through ceiling.
 Roebuck Ship container placement adjustments.
 Roebuck Ship ladders adjustments at the entrance on the ship.
 Venus Ship boxes in the air.
 Venus Ship ladders adjustments at the entrance on the ship.
 Venus Ship engine room doors blocked.
 Flame Ship flying torch box.
 Pluto Ship container placement adjustments.
 Lydia Ship third floor pipes removed.
 Lydia ship Rooms placement fixes.
 Justinian Ship flying steel pole.

⚓ Please write to us what you think about the changes we made and join our Discord channel!

FULL LIST OF CHANGES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/bfe835ba4532ab2e8b2949d06cb9123104a7aa87.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

Regards, 
Ship Graveyard Simulator Team

notes.title: OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE SET!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the release date of the full version! 🥳

⚓ Ship Graveyard Simulator will be released on:
NOVEMBER 10, 2021!
We realize that many of you have been waiting eagerly to play the game. The entire team is delighted that you will be able to play the full game next week. Your support, opinions and suggestions during the demo and prologue were an amazing knowledge base for us and what still needs to be improved. It is thanks to you that we have managed to improve the gameplay even more. The whole team thanks you for that.

We hope that reading about this news makes you as excited as it makes us! This is the final countdown!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/65ced2c6c0c4c9a28815702040a2d0bc4f6cfc55.png

We have one more small request for you:
If you'd like to support us, consider adding the game to your wishlist and inviting your friends to do so. The larger the number of wishlists, the more people see this game recommended. Wishlisting does wonders for indie studios like ours, and you can make a wonder happen. Thank you in advance. 😊

Join our Discord for a more of a community experience:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

We are back to work, see you soon!
Ship Graveyard Simulator Team
